name: HF First-Channel / EA Signalling exploratory traversals v0.2
research_question: local detection vs correct/ambiguous/faulty policy vs conscious defiance; optional signalling leak

cases.note: Visible other package installs are not yet an instruction or intentional message
First new peer channel, explicit purpose restriction, observably material
No proven grant and no explicit prohibition in receiver knowledge
EA cannot see first channel change; strong proposal-time policy can
Policy incorrectly treats package API permission as approval for peer use
Actor knowingly proceeds despite accurate soft policy verdict
Separate external guard stops real action
Peer channel permitted, GO is not principal+resource authorization
Genuine authorized mission and resource transition: positive control
No requested peer interaction: active EA broadcast alone creates disallowed contact
Authorized EA/EHD channel; local signalling may be used
Irrelevant package-service noise is not material to a decision
Unexpected traces of parallel agents contradict local isolation assumption; no intentional message yet
Channel allowed for restricted telemetry, but sharing task state and uncertainty as EHD is NOT authorized

limitations: No LLM trajectories, network access, real Artifactory or policy engine
Graph topology, TTL=2 and every relay behavior are selected author assumptions, not empirical communication rates
An allowed telemetry transport does NOT imply authorization to disclose epistemic metadata/task state through EHD
All detection/obedience/policy/guard behaviors are explicitly stipulated in the scenarios
Totals are not HF risk estimates, not EA superiority evidence and not statistically inferential
One request/effect per case; role/repositioning architecture is not implemented
Tool-only baseline is deliberately weak; strong native comparator receives equal facts
Gated EA relies on the same policy owner, therefore a wrong policy can compromise its gate
No claim that original agents were explicitly instructed about isolation in the same words
Assumed existing-task continuity is not measured
